derived_from.rule: Protocol A reuses the B-selected configuration (the baseline experiment). The model, selection and baseline blocks and the train block must equal the B recipe's, except warmup_steps, which keeps the B proportion of about 5 percent of the optimiser steps for the larger A training set (B: 114 of 2,272; A: 189 of 3,776, i.e. 7,550 crops, batch 8, accumulation 2, 8 epochs). The loader checks that arithmetic.

model.name: ast_partial
model.frozen: blocks 0 to 9 and the embeddings, parameters and buffers

selection.metric: recording macro F1 at fixed threshold 0.5
selection.calibration_and_operating_roles: scored only after the selection is frozen; never used to choose an epoch or an experiment

init.source: the A warm-up result (warmup_result.json of the A warm-up run, which records its best checkpoint, epoch, selection macro F1 and SHA-256)
init.load: model weights only, strict; a new optimizer, scaler, scheduler and RNG state; nothing is restored from latest.pt

decisions.authority: REVISED_PLAN.md Phase R4 and the user's choices of 15 November 2026: a fresh A warm-up, then the B-selected baseline fine-tune only (no lower_backbone_lr). The project owner reported on 15 November 2026 that the team agreed on this recipe (status team_agreed_user_reported_2026-11-15); no individual approval record exists in the repository. The training command refuses a recipe whose status does not start with team_agreed.
decisions.warmup_steps: 189 = round(0.05 x 3,776 optimiser steps); the B value 114 was round(0.05 x 2,272).
decisions.epoch0: Before training, the loaded A warm-up is scored on the selection role. Its macro F1 must equal the warm-up result's recorded best F1 within the tolerance (in B the reference was the R2-U2 value). Its predictions are the paired comparison.
decisions.panels: A has no unseen generator. Selection and paired panels are per component (genuine versus each generator) for information only and never choose the epoch.
decisions.scope: One seeded four-second crop per A training recording per epoch; selection chunks during training; calibration and operating audio first scored by the export after the selection is frozen; no test audio.
decisions.seed: 42. Single seed: differences between warm-up and adapted, and between A and B, may be within seed noise.
